author: Bill Muehlenberg
title: The Revolt of the Masses: Resisting Islam's Threat to the West
text:
Five brave voices on the war we are in with Islam, sharia law, and mass migration: Plenty of people have no clue about the fact that the Judeo-Christian West is in a civilisational struggle with Islam. But thankfully many others are aware of this life and death struggle. Indeed, as I type this, millions of Spaniards are marching in the streets of Spanish cities demanding that the treasonous socialist and Islamophile Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez resign.
He allowed the invasion and destruction of Ceuta and has been turning Spain into a third world hellhole. Many other Western leaders have been doing similar things, which explains the rise and rise of Donald Trump, Nigel Farage, Geert Wilders, Eva Vlaardingerbroek, Marine Le Pen, Alice Weidel, Santiago Abascal, Afroditi Latinopoulou, Pauline Hanson, and others.
If you do not know all those names, you should. Some may well lead their respective nations in the months ahead. The truth is, ordinary people are fed up. They have had enough of mass migration and the promotion of Islam while the West is going up in flames.
Here then are just five individuals who have some influence, and who think straight on all this. I offer a number of brief quotes from each one:
Gad Saad
“There is no political Islam; no moderate Islam; no Islamism; no extremist militant Islamism; no Jihadism; no Wahhabism; no self-radicalized Islamism; no radical Islam; no radical Islamism. There is only Islam. Countless Islamic leaders and scholars have said so. Only Westerners come up with euphemisms to protect Islam as though the latter fictitious terms are something distinct from Islam.”
“Any immigrant that belongs to an ideology that has tenets contrary to the Western tradition should be banned.”
“A society dies when it cares more about exhibiting infinite tolerance and empathy than invoking its survival instinct. It truly is that simple.”
“Every single individual who has entered the West illegally should be deported. Every person who has entered legally and who is loyal to an ideology that is antithetical to the West’s foundational values should also be deported. This is a battle for the soul of humanity. Wake up.”
“When in the minority, act meek and whine about justice for the minorities. When in the majority, show no mercy and subjugate if not eradicate all minorities. Any idea whose strategy this is? A very successful strategy by the way.”
“Islam always wishes to engage in interfaith dialogue when it is in the minority. Islam does not engage in interfaith dialogue when it is in the majority because the other faiths seem to magically disappear from those societies.”
“In order for the West to win this civilizational battle, it must:
1) Proudly and unequivocally defend Western values;
2) Reject cultural relativism and the unicornia vision of multiculturalism;
3) Recommit to individual dignity over the celebration of collective identity politics;
4) Recognize that all cultures are not equal;
5) Recognize that all religious beliefs are not equally consistent with Western values;
6) Recognize that all immigrants are not equally likely to assimilate and adopt Western values;
7) Recognize that immigrants who espouse intolerable values that seek to destroy our civilization will be deported (en masse);
8) Implement a rational immigration policy that recognizes the importance of cultural homophily (choosing immigrants who hail from cultures that possess similar values to those of the host nations);
9) Exhibit zero tolerance for seditious belief systems; such systems can be criminalized if they constitute an existential threat to our freedoms and liberties.”
“For the first time in recorded history, a civilization has decided that the most enlightened virtue is to surrender its culture, heritage, women, and children without putting up any defence. Suicidal empathy shall prove to be the demise of the West.”
Marco Rubio
“If there were more countries like Israel, the world would be a safer and better place.”
“Mass migration is not some fringe concern of little consequence. It’s destabilizing societies all across the West.”
“We in America have NO interest in being polite and orderly caretakers of the West’s managed decline!”
“Radical Islam is apocalyptic for the West. Either they win, or we win.”
“All radical Islamic movements in the world identify the West, but the United States in particular, as the greatest evil on Earth. Radical Islam wants to expand, it’s in their nature.”
“Radical Islam wants to expand. It seeks to control more territories & more people. That’s a clear & imminent threat to the United States.”
Brandon Gill
“Socialism and Islamism have more in common than the Left wants to admit. Both seek power over every part of your life, public and private.”
“You can either have a first world society or you can have mass immigration. You can’t have both.”
“We can either stop Islamic immigration now or our children will pay the price – just like the working class girls in Great Britain did.”
“Allowing Muslim immigration is one of the most idiotic policy mistakes our country has ever made.”
“Calling you a racist has always been a tool the left uses to shut down debate. They can’t tell us why importing millions of people from cultures incompatible with our own is a good thing for America. They just call you a racist and hope you’ll shut up. Well, I never will.”
“You can’t preserve civilization by importing people who hate it.”
“How many Americans have to get Allahu Akbar’ed before we realize Islam is a problem?”
“If you hate Western Civilization, you don’t deserve to live in it.”
“Islam didn’t come to the United States on the Mayflower. We imported it relatively recently via a suicidal immigration system. Importing radical Islam will destroy America just like it’s destroying Europe right now.”
“I don’t want to go to my polling place on Election Day and see women in burkas. That’s not American and it never will be American.”
“Mass migration touches every part of American life. It suppresses wages. It drives up rents. It overwhelms hospitals. It strains our social institutions. It makes our roads less safe.”
“I have a bright idea. If it has to be explained to somebody that rape is bad, you probably shouldn’t bring that person to your country in the first place.”
“The UK government issued a nine-page behavioral guide for asylum seekers explaining that women have the right to not be raped. Civilized societies should not have to import people and then teach them how to be civilized. That is an indictment of a completely broken immigration system.”
Dan Burmawi
“Fear of Islam is the symptom of a healthy society that wants to survive. The less a society fears Islam, the faster it will vanish.”
“I have lived in five different countries and visited over forty. I lived as a Muslim and I lived as a Christian. And after twenty years, one conclusion has become impossible to escape: Christian culture is superior to all others.”
“Reading from the Quran at the Harvard graduation is not diversity. It’s stupidity. It’s naivety. This book literally calls for war on everyone who rejects the rule of Allah, and that means the United States. This book is behind more than 60,000 Islamic terror attacks in the last few decades alone. Ignoring these facts, pretending, because you happen to know some nice Muslims, that the Quran is just another religious book, is what will end Western civilization.”
“It is far easier to radicalize Muslims in the West than in Islamic countries. In Islamic countries, dictators can crush any Islamic movement without risking the ‘Islamophobia’ charge. In the West, freedom is weaponized against the West: governments can’t move until tangible terrorism occurs, and during the ideological phase nothing can be done, the ideology shelters behind religious freedom, and anyone who tries to confront it is branded an Islamophobe.”
“For 1,400 years Islam forced itself on everyone: Jews, Christians, pagans. Today it is forcing itself on the West, to destroy it and take over the ruins.”
“When you visit the 9/11 Museum in New York, beneath the ground where the Twin Towers once stood, you’ll find a section called “What Have We Learned?” This section is not about the ideology that drove 19 men to hijack planes. It’s not about the religious worldview that justified slaughtering thousands of civilians. No, that section is about New York City’s mistakes in dealing with the dust and its long-term health effects on first responders and residents. Tucked away in a corner, almost hidden, you’ll find the museum’s weak defense of Islam, framing Al-Qaeda and Islamism as nothing more than a political faction that happened to emerge in the mid-20th century. It’s designed not to offend, not to name the ideology that inspired the attacks. America didn’t learn the real lesson of 9/11. The lesson they should have put front and center is: if you ignore the ideology, if you pretend Islam is blameless, you guarantee that the same ideas will strike again. But instead, the largest section is devoted to dust particles and respiratory illnesses. That’s why New Yorkers got a jihad-loving mayor 24 years after 9/11.”
“The threat Islam poses to the West is not limited to another 9/11. The real danger is not spectacular attacks, but long-term cultural transformation. Self-censorship, which effectively empties the law of meaning. Regional Islamification, where tribal norms begin to replace the laws of freedom at the local level. The election of officials whose worldviews stand in direct opposition to the values America represents. Shifts in foreign policy that undermine U.S. interests. The replacement of long-standing American customs with foreign practices that do not reflect the values that built this country. A declining sense of civic ownership driven by an ideologically toxic relationship between authority and Muslim communities. Sex segregation in Islamified areas, and a reduction in women’s participation in the workforce, placing additional pressure on the welfare system. Add to this domestic violence and the introduction of curricula in schools that are misaligned with American principles. Another 9/11 should be the least of your concerns.”
“October 7 is what Jewish life would be without a Jewish state. October 7 is also what Christian life in the West would be without a Jewish state. You understood the first statement. But the second one confuses you. If it weren’t for the existence of Israel, the caliphate would have been reestablished decades ago.”
Elon Musk
“If tolerance means the end of Western Civilization, then we cannot be tolerant.”
“If people come to a country with values completely opposed to ours… I AM AGAINST IT. I am against rape. I am against murder. I am against imposing laws and norms that go exactly against everything the West has built with blood, freedom, and progress.”
“Anyone doubting the severity and depravity of the mass gang rapes of little girls in Britain, go to the source material and read the court transcripts. I did. It is worse than you could possibly imagine.”
“I am not against Muslims. I am against people coming to a country with antithetical views, I am against rape and murder!”
“Unless there is more bravery to stand up for what is fair and right, Christianity will perish.”
[1843 words]
